entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I think I need to make a return? I got a helmet a few days ago, and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me your order number? And just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

My order number is... VF88602. A fault? I don't think so. I mean, the box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. It’s just... the color. It looked so different on the website. I don't know, it's all a bit overwhelming. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help. It's no problem at all. It's important that you're happy with the color of your gear. And your safety is our top priority, so we want you to have a helmet you love and will wear.
Right, exactly. I just want something that feels right. So what do I do?

I see here you received it six days ago. Since the helmet is unused and it's well within our 90-day return window for apparel and gear, we can definitely process a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now.
Oh! That's it? You're sending a label? That's such a relief.

Yes, just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund back to your original payment method. The email has all the instructions. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
